raw.query: SELECT window_name, policy, forecast_model, quantile, p99_ms FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true AND window_name IN ('burst1','burst3') AND ((policy = 'reactive' AND quantile = 'p90') OR (policy = 'forecast' AND quantile = 'p90')) ORDER BY window_name, policy, p99_ms;
raw.observed: Reactive+quantile='p90' burst3 p99 spans 1,973.291 to 11,567.99 ms; forecast+quantile='p90' burst3 p99 = 588.37 (exact match). Burst1 reactive p99 spans 637.7-904.7 ms (passes-like, ≤ forecast's 880.7). Reactive+quantile='p90' has NO rows on week-scale e7-e18/steady24h windows; the unsuffixed reactive on those windows shows p99 from 588 (e7) up to 50,855 ms (e11), i.e. generally catastrophic, contradicting 'passes week scale'.
raw.evidence: v_pool_latency matches the cited 1,973-11,568 ms vs 588 ms exactly, but 'passes week scale' is unsuported — week-scale reactive runs reach tens of thousands of ms while the cited headroom configuration has no rows there.
